checks: Fan measurements expire without any cloud event; Auto remains the setting and both readouts become unavailable.
Actual node normalization retains LM393 RPM, quality and timestamp; control renders fan setting beside calibrated measurement.
FILTER is absent, and separate vertical/horizontal swing actions retain the other direction and keep legacy vertical aliases consistent.
Current settings update their supported special-function values without a page reload.
Control heading and selector use the controller display name while retaining the persisted AC manufacturer.
Plain action feedback keeps backend errors visible and does not apply a failed setting.
Production Control panel preserves received fractional settings and sends whole-degree app targets.
Detected exact Fujitsu model preserves received quarter-degree values while app controls use whole degrees and retain model-specific functions.
Fan mode disables desktop temperature adjustments; the retired remote layout is absent.
A different unknown AC on the same controller does not inherit the previous profile or fabricate controls.
Production dashboard quick adjustment uses the exact model and the next whole degree, preserving the received setpoint until the user adjusts it.
Initial dashboard cards and in-place name edits use the saved controller display name, hide manufacturer/raw IDs, escape custom text, and retain stable command targets.
